comment: the adjudication widget: paper's intent presented on the plane as a form; Julian's ruling returns as an event. The first widget where BOTH directions of the data→infer→intend→act loop run through the log, with chat demoted to signpost.

id.comment: fold key — latest card per id wins

status.comment: presentation hint only; a card_response overrides

domain.fold: latest card per id; latest card_response per card id

on.comment: re-posting the id reopens — supersede pattern

derives.outstanding: cards with no response — the 'what paper wants' list

system.tick: shared 2000ms chat poll (renderCards called per poll)
system.ingest: extension steers card_response into session as '[card HH:MM:SS] ...' (requires /reload after 08:22 edit)

render.template: bordered card: title, status badge, optional table, optional radio form + write-in textarea + 'rule it' button; ruled cards dim and show the ruling

knownGaps: no card_delete / expiry — the T-form-probe test card renders forever (labeled 'ignore')
no agent-side notification beyond the extension steer; a ruled card while extension is unloaded is silent
writein flag declared in schema but render always shows the textarea
